title: Ash-Shams 91:1-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ash-Shams 91:1-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 15. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا (١) وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا (٢) وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا (٣) وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا (٤) وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا (٥) وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا (٦) وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا (٧) فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

questions.q: Chunk and link Ash-Shams 91:1-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 91:1-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 91:1-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: List the six things Allah swears by in 91:1 to 6.
questions.a: The sun, the moon, the day, the night, the sky, the earth.

questions.q: Every ayah of 91:1 to 8 ends the same way. With which sound, and why does it help memory?
questions.a: With 'haa' (ـهَا): the rhyme helps us remember the order.

questions.q: In 91:8 Allah says He inspired the soul with ...
questions.a: A) its wickedness and its righteousness. 91:8: the soul knows right and wrong. We choose the good.

questions.q: Think again: The sun, the moon, the sky, the earth: Allah swears by them all, then by the soul. Why might the soul come last?
questions.a: After the great signs outside us, Allah points to the sign inside us: the soul, shown right and wrong (91:7 to 8).
